authorization.operatorMessage: Yes, I approve your experimentation efforts going forward. Please proceed.

dormantFiniteWidth.reason: Explicit transport-only tokens; sharp chart forbids finite-width rescue. These values do not authorize regulator-dependent evolution.

outcomeControls.eventMeaning: Post-run finite threshold witnesses, not live stopping events: distance 0.02 is one named pair close approach, not literal collision or whole-assembly collapse; fixed-origin radius 0.8 is radial excursion that can include rigid translation, not constituent separation or permanent escape.
outcomeControls.thresholdQuantifiers: Close approach: there exists a distinct pair and observed time with distance <= 0.02. Radial excursion: there exists a member and observed time with origin radius >= 0.8. Persistence: every distinct pair has distance > 0.02 and every member has origin radius < 0.8 throughout the complete observed interval [0,0.5]. Unresolved bounds are not witnesses.
outcomeControls.persistenceMeaning: Measured finite-horizon generated history stays outside collapse threshold and inside separation radius, with independent dynamics checks and declared sensitivity agreement; no permanent retention or stability claim.
outcomeControls.incompleteMeaning: Unresolved unless accepted generated history independently proves a declared threshold event. Zero accepted steps do not close the requested evolution experiment.

independentDynamics.comparisonPolicy: interval overlap and midpoint delta within the fine-rung declared position, velocity or acceleration tolerance; no bit parity or global solution enclosure
independentDynamics.authority: Independent first-step numerical compatibility and final-snapshot root/acceleration comparison, not a global validated-integration theorem or independent verification of propagated EOM uncertainty.
independentDynamics.initialStateLimitation: The EOM solver uses endpoint_state_hull centers; the frozen oracle uses last-piece nominal coefficients with enlarged scalar radii. These are distinct constructions; actual first-step numerical compatibility is checked, not assumed.
independentDynamics.uncertaintyPropagationLimitation: The frozen oracle carries endpoint radii unchanged into the candidate before adding local full/half error. The EOM solver additionally transports velocity and acceleration radii with step length. Agreement does not validate the EOM propagated uncertainty rule. Initial history radii remain unchanged; MPFR refinement cannot remove data uncertainty.

numericalScopeLimitations: Bundled step/root/acceleration/tolerance sensitivity is conditional on the same fixed initial-history uncertainty; it is not history refinement or an absolute solution-error proof.
Fine root tolerance 5e-9 is tighter than the accepted prescribed ladder and has no inherited evolution acceptance. Fail-closed uncertainty-floor halts remain unresolved.

The 100000-panel independent geometry cap can be exhausted before 4096 accepted atomic steps (8 panels per each of four quarter pieces). This is an unresolved independent-check budget boundary; no cap expansion after outcomes is authorized.
stoppingEvents: lost observation or unsafe host resource state

runtime.launcherPolicy: env -i with only declared launcherEnvironment; no preloaded Node or dynamic-loader options
runtime.trustedPlatformPremises: macOS kernel and system shared-cache libraries; runtime/library identity checks do not prove platform correctness
runtime.pythonObservedExecutableMeaning: Observed runtime executable in synthetic consumer process records; the invoked shared-venv path passes through the separately bound launcher.

buildArtifactScope: Executable plus post-build static-library identity; project sources checked before/after build, external compiler dependency identities recorded after build only.
